snippet.title: No Clean Start — Official Demo Release Trailer | Play Free on Steam
snippet.description:
The official NO CLEAN START demo is now available for FREE on Steam!

▶ PLAY THE FREE DEMO:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4600120/NO_CLEAN_START_Demo/

NO CLEAN START is a first-person survival horror roguelite set inside a hostile underground facility overrun by infected creatures.

Explore dangerous environments, manage limited supplies, and fight to survive. Every expedition is a new opportunity — and every mistake can be your last.

**WHAT TO EXPECT:**
- First-person survival horror with roguelite mechanics
- Dangerous expeditions through an infected underground facility
- Limited ammunition and resources
- Tactical combat, stealth, and environmental interactions
- Terrifying enemies that react to your actions and the noise you make
- Darkness, exploration, and unpredictable encounters
- The first 10 levels available in the free demo

Fight, sneak, improvise, or run. Survival is never guaranteed.

NO CLEAN START is developed by IndieGala using Unreal Engine 5.

**PLAY THE DEMO FOR FREE**
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4600120/NO_CLEAN_START_Demo/

**WISHLIST THE FULL GAME**
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4339590/No_Clean_Start/

**PRESS KIT**
[https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ppJTeyJ_F0MDE0VnX75GLnAVpmw61Kyc/view?usp=drive_link]

Full game planned for March 4, 2027.

Developed and published by IndieGala.
